author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using an angle grinder with a diamond blade to cut my tile. Then I use a small chamfer cone to polish the rounded edge. I leave a 1/16 inch expansion joint that will be filled with silicone. Tiling showers can be tough, so I created an online course to make it easier at https://homerepairtutor.com/new-course-tile-shower-with-8x20-porcelain/
title: How to Cut Tiles Around Bathtubs - #shorts #tileshower #diy
